title: Satish's tomatoes
body: On a bus in Maharashtra, Rishabh sat next to Satish, a tomato farmer returning from the mandi after selling his harvest. Satish explained that his red, juicy tomatoes were not just a gift of sunshine and rain. Canals and electric water pumps helped irrigate his fields. Good roads helped trucks carry the tomatoes to the city. Cold storage kept them fresh until they were sold, and the internet helped him learn about the best inputs and market prices. Rishabh and Satish wondered how physical infrastructure is connected like pieces of a puzzle, helping the safe and timely movement of people and goods.
